---
title: "World Flags"
format: html
---

```{r}
#| echo: false
library(rnaturalearth)
library(geojsonsf)
library(png)

# Send the list of PNG filenames in w2560/ to Observable JS
flag_files <- list.files("w2560", pattern = "\\.png$")
ojs_define(flags = flag_files)

# Compute a color-and-layout profile for each flag to find the 6 closest matches
feat <- t(sapply(file.path("w2560", flag_files), \(f) {
  img <- readPNG(f, native = TRUE)
  sub <- img[round(seq(1, nrow(img), length.out = 24)), round(seq(1, ncol(img), length.out = 36))]
  R <- bitwAnd(sub, 255) / 255
  G <- bitwAnd(bitwShiftR(sub, 8), 255) / 255
  B <- bitwAnd(bitwShiftR(sub, 16), 255) / 255
  grp <- list(rep(1:4, each = 6, times = 36), rep(1:6, each = 144))
  grid <- c(tapply(R, grp, mean), tapply(G, grp, mean), tapply(B, grp, mean))
  colors <- c(
    mean(R > 0.6 & G < 0.35 & B < 0.35), # red
    mean(R > 0.8 & G > 0.8 & B > 0.8),   # white
    mean(B > 0.4 & R < 0.35),            # blue
    mean(G > 0.4 & R < 0.35 & B < 0.4),  # green
    mean(R > 0.7 & G > 0.6 & B < 0.35),  # yellow
    mean(R < 0.2 & G < 0.2 & B < 0.2)    # black
  ) * 4
  c(grid, colors)
}))
rownames(feat) <- flag_files
d <- as.matrix(dist(feat))
similar <- setNames(lapply(flag_files, \(k) setdiff(names(sort(d[k, ])), k)[1:6]), flag_files)
ojs_define(similar_flags = similar)

# Send country polygons and center coordinates as GeoJSON to Observable JS
world <- ne_countries(scale = 50, returnclass = "sf")[, c("name", "iso_a2_eh", "label_x", "label_y")]
ojs_define(world_geojson = sf_geojson(world))
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
// Create a dropdown menu to pick a flag file
viewof selected = Inputs.select(flags, {label: "Select a flag:", value: "us.png"})

// Helper to get the full country name from a flag filename
regionNames = new Intl.DisplayNames(["en"], {type: "region"})
ukNames = ({"gb-eng": "England", "gb-nir": "Northern Ireland", "gb-sct": "Scotland", "gb-wls": "Wales"})
getName = (file) => {
  const code = file.replace(".png", "");
  return ukNames[code] || regionNames.of(code.toUpperCase());
}

// Display the full country name above the chosen flag image
html`<h3>${getName(selected)}</h3>
<img src="w2560/${selected}" style="max-width: 600px; border: 1px solid #ccc;">`

// Display a clickable gallery of the 6 most similar flags
html`<h4>Similar Flags</h4>
<div style="display: flex; gap: 12px; flex-wrap: wrap; max-width: 600px;">
  ${similar_flags[selected].map(f => {
    const card = html`<div style="width: 110px; cursor: pointer; text-align: center; font-size: 0.8rem;">
      <img src="w2560/${f}" style="width: 100%; height: 65px; object-fit: cover; border: 1px solid #ccc;">
      <div>${getName(f)}</div>
    </div>`;
    card.onclick = () => {
      viewof selected.value = f;
      viewof selected.dispatchEvent(new Event("input", {bubbles: true}));
    };
    return card;
  })}
</div>`

// Load Leaflet CSS and library for the interactive map
html`<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/leaflet.css">`
L = require("leaflet@1.9.4")
world = JSON.parse(world_geojson)

// Draw an interactive map centered on the selected country
{
  const div = DOM.element("div", {style: "height: 400px; max-width: 600px; margin-top: 1rem; background: #d4ebf2;"});
  yield div;
  const map = L.map(div, {attributionControl: false}).setView([20, 0], 2);

  const code = selected.replace(".png", "").toUpperCase();
  L.geoJSON(world, {
    style: f => ({
      color: f.properties.iso_a2_eh === code ? "crimson" : "#888",
      weight: f.properties.iso_a2_eh === code ? 2 : 1,
      fillColor: f.properties.iso_a2_eh === code ? "crimson" : "#f5f5f0",
      fillOpacity: f.properties.iso_a2_eh === code ? 0.6 : 1
    })
  }).addTo(map);

  const country = world.features.find(f => f.properties.iso_a2_eh === code);
  if (country) {
    map.setView([country.properties.label_y, country.properties.label_x], 4);
  }
}
```
